The '''Imperial Senate Sentinels''' were a subdivision of the [[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guard]] who served the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. They protected the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from looters and were specially trained to combat and kill [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], they were encountered by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]].

==Overview==
The Sentinels were a subdivision of the [[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guard]]<ref name="GaW" /> and dressed similarly to the Royal Guards, but their armor and robes were gray and white rather than red, and their helmets resembled those of late [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&ndash;era [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]]. They wielded powerful [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]] that could effectively block a Jedi's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which aided them greatly in their work. They had robotic voices<ref name="TFU" /> and were thought to be [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]].<ref name="GaW" /> Imperial Senate Sentinels worked alongside [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] to guard the remains of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="TFU" />

==History==
The Sentinels were handpicked by [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to guard the Jedi Temple on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Once there, they watched over the ruins and protected them from looters and those who sought to plunder the secrets of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, their true purpose was to wait for and kill any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who returned to the temple.<ref name="TFUdatabank" /> In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]] came to the Jedi Temple multiple times to further his training, whereupon he was attacked by a number of Imperial Senate Sentinels. When Marek arrived for his [[Starkiller's Trial of Insight|second visit]], they attempted to warn him that he was to be detained as the Emperor had declared a quarantine at the Jedi Temple, but when he visited for a [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|third and final time]], they attacked him pre-emptively without giving a warning.<ref name="TFU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Senate Sentinels made their first appearance in the first trip to the Jedi Temple in the Playstation 2, Playstation Portable, and Nintendo Wii versions of the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' video game]]. In the game, they were only referred to as "Imperial Sentinels," not to be confused with the [[Imperial Sentinel]]s who guarded Palpatine's [[Emperor's Citadel|Citadel]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. They were given a proper name and revealed to be a sect of the Imperial Senate Guard in the [[2009]] roleplaying-game supplement ''[[Galaxy at War]]''.
